authority: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government / contributing local planning authorities
note: Previously unused official public no-login source window. Current Planning Data Local plan dataset provides local-plan references plus local-plan-boundary/local-planning-authority identifiers and organisation codes; the official local-plan specification requires a permanent local-plan reference, the boundary reference and responsible organisation code. Up to 50 records were considered as the bounded source window. The fixed future_growth_3 owner/partition/checkpoint still exposes no authoritative local-plan reference, local-plan-boundary/LPA/LAD identifier or name, organisation code, postcode, UPRN, coordinate/grid reference, or equivalent selector. Therefore none of the returned local-plan records can be bound to this slot without guessing. No coverage_area_id is selected, no source-area geometry is emitted, no parcel is accepted, and no Plan0 package is emitted.
